summary: A sortable list whose rows slide to their new position instead of teleporting when the sort changes (First, Last, Invert, Play).
use: Sorting or filtering a table, leaderboard or card list where the user must keep track of which row went where.
spec: `MotionStage` with `label="FLIP reorder: rows slide to their new place when the sort changes"` and `loop={2400}`
Measure `getBoundingClientRect().top` before the reorder, `await tick()`, measure again, then `el.animate(` from `translateY` of the difference to `translateY(0)`
Rows keep a stable key: `{#each ordered as r (r.id)}` so Svelte moves the node instead of recreating it
Under reduced motion the order changes with no animation
